en.name: Physics & Energy
en.title: Songs about Physics & Energy – Thermodynamics, Kirchhoff, EROEI | Etatisti
en.desc: Songs about the laws of thermodynamics, Kirchhoff, Carnot, EROEI and energy & civilization. Album FACTS not FICTION in English, German and Italian.
en.intro: FACTS not FICTION turns physics into songs: one track for each law of thermodynamics – equilibrium, conservation of energy, entropy, absolute zero – plus Kirchhoff's circuit rules, the Carnot limit, the energy return on energy invested (EROEI), geology and how energy surplus built civilization. The album is in English, with a German and an Italian edition on the way. The single ENERGY VS. HYSTERY, featuring physicist and science cabaret artist Vince Ebert, takes on the energy debate – in German and in English.
audience: Engineers, physicists and technicians
Students and teachers of physics, chemistry and engineering
Anyone following the energy transition debate
Fans of Vince Ebert and science cabaret
People who like to learn something while listening
